[[File:Stan.png|thumb|250px|Stan]] '''Stan''' (Japanese: '''スタン''' ''Stan'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY110|An Electrifying Rage!]]''. He is a paramedic. Stan was delivering medicine to [[Joule Town]] for a sick child in his ambulance. However, there was a lightning storm brought on by {{p|Zapdos}}, and one lightning strike loosened a boulder. As a result, he crashed his ambulance after swerving to avoid the boulder loosened after it fell. With his ambulance out of commission and his leg injured, he was forced to take shelter in a nearby cave, which {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} subsequently came across. He asked the group for help in delivering the medicine, explaining that the cave is also a shortcut to Joule Town but became blocked from a rock-slide some time ago. Stan was later escorted to town by Ash's friends, where he received medical attention from [[Nurse Joy]] and was stated to be on the way to a full recovery by the end of the episode. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{electric color light}}|bordercolor={{electric color dark}} |ja=佐藤健輔 ''[[Kensuke Satō]]'' |en=[[Jake Paque]] |fi=Arto Nieminen |es_eu=Nacho Aramburu}}
